description: Permanently deletes one SuuntoPlus Guide from the user's account by id. Use list_guides to find the id. This removes it from the Suunto app / apizone catalogue; it does not reach into the watch to un-pin a copy already synced there. Write operation (irreversible).

guideId.description: Guide id, from list_guides or from a previous push_*_guide response.

name: delete_guide
title: Delete SuuntoPlus guide
